payload.notes:
SecureSH 0.1.9.

Self-updater now works in the packaged app and AUTO-UPDATES: on launch, if a newer signed version exists it installs and restarts automatically (no prompt, no manual quit). Fixes the old 'running from source / git pull' message in the exe.

Includes everything from 0.1.8:
- Native RDP in-canvas (no Docker): renders inside SecureSH, resizes, clipboard; fixed stuck modifiers and black non-primary monitors.
- Remote Desktop is a native streamer with a WebRTC -> H.264/NVENC -> JPEG fallback ladder: dirty-rectangle tiling (much lower bandwidth), hardware H.264 via WebCodecs, full WebRTC video + system audio (Opus) + input over a data channel.
- Security: master-password prompt on startup, change password, 'ask on every connection', 'remember on this device'; settable/stable web-server token.

Note: updating TO 0.1.9 from 0.1.7/0.1.8 is a manual download (older builds have the old updater); after that, updates are automatic.
